source_refs.note: 3. Secretory/Post-Ovulatory Phase (Days 15-28): a main subheading of Female Reproductive Cycle - The Menstrual Cycle, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 80-82.

blocks.text: After ovulation, LH stimulates the ruptured Graafian follicle to develop into a yellow structure called the corpus luteum. Corpus luteum secretes estrogen and progesterone hormones which make the endometrium more vascular and glandular.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: In human females, menstrual cycle stops around 50 year of age and it is termed as menopause.

If fertilization does not occur, the corpus luteum starts to degenerate. As a result, the anterior pituitary stops secreting LH. The destruction of corpus luteum also results in an abrupt fall in the concentration of estrogen and progesterone. It causes the thickened endometrium to be shed with bleeding i.e., menstruation on day 28.
book_errors: As a result, the anterior pituitary stops secreting LH.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: Cause and effect are reversed here. Progesterone and estrogen from the corpus luteum lower LH (and FSH) secretion by negative feedback. If fertilization does not occur (so there is no hCG), the fall in LH makes the corpus luteum degenerate.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: When the ovulated oocyte is fertilized, the tiny embryo secretes human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG). This hormone maintains the corpus luteum. So, the levels of estrogen and progesterone keep high and menstruation is prevented. Because hCG comes from the embryonic chorion and not the mother, it is the hormone that is tested for in all pregnancy tests.

blocks.alt: Chart of days 0 to 28 in three rows, divided into the menstrual phase, follicular phase, ovulation at day 14 and secretory phase. Ovary: a follicle grows, ruptures at ovulation, becomes a corpus luteum and regresses. Hormone levels: FSH rises early with a small peak at ovulation; estrogen peaks just before ovulation and again around day 21; LH surges at day 13 to 14; progesterone peaks around day 22. Endometrium: shed in the first days, then thickens until late in the cycle.
